name: Automatic Rally Ratio Secondary Test
note: Wyckoff Phase A read as a supply-exhaustion test: a selling climax at a 40-bar low on 2.5x volume and a 1.5 ATR spread, an automatic rally worth at least 2 ATR AND at least 1.5x the climax bars own range (the discriminating gate), then a secondary test that holds ABOVE the climax low on under 60% of climax volume, and only then a close back through the test high on 1.2x average volume. Target is the 1x measured move projected off the rally leg, stop the climax low; both are exact prices checked on the close because the shared harness only takes ATR multiples. Mirror for the buying climax. Calibration note: on 5-minute bars the written secondary-test window (3-30 bars) and proximity band (0.75 ATR) almost never both hold after a 2 ATR rally - the whole chain fired once or twice per symbol in 45 days - so the defaults here are a 60-bar window and a 2.0 ATR band, with the band swept back down to 1.0. Every other threshold is as written.
source: Wyckoff accumulation schematic Phase A (PS, SC, AR, ST) as codified in the StockCharts ChartSchool 'The Wyckoff Method' article and reproduced in the TradingView 'Wyckoff Accumulation Phase Map' (AGProLabs) and 'Wyckoff Pattern Indicator' (Dr_AtulGoswami) script descriptions. The ARratio gate and all numeric thresholds are the ideas own quantification - the source literature states the sequence qualitatively only.

def family_init(ctx):
    """Wyckoff Phase A: climax -> automatic rally -> secondary test -> trigger.

    Every stage is stamped on the bar that completes it, so the entry bar only
    ever depends on bars at or before it.
    """
    bars = ctx.bars
    n = len(bars)
    hi = [float(b["h"]) for b in bars]
    lo = [float(b["l"]) for b in bars]
    cl = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]
    vo = [float(b.get("v") or 0.0) for b in bars]

    ex_n = max(5, int(ctx.p.extreme_win))     # bars the climax must be extreme over
    vmult = float(ctx.p.climax_vol)
    smult = float(ctx.p.climax_spread)
    ar_win = max(2, int(ctx.p.ar_win))
    ar_atr = float(ctx.p.ar_atr)
    ratio_min = float(ctx.p.ar_ratio)
    st_lo = max(1, int(ctx.p.st_wait))
    st_hi = max(st_lo + 1, int(ctx.p.st_win))
    st_vol = float(ctx.p.st_vol_frac)
    st_band = float(ctx.p.st_band_atr)
    st_spread = float(ctx.p.st_spread_atr)
    trig_win = max(1, int(ctx.p.trig_win))
    trig_vol = float(ctx.p.trig_vol)
    mm = float(ctx.p.measured_move)
    stop_pad = float(ctx.p.stop_pad_atr)

    # --- Wilder ATR(14) and a 20-bar average volume, computed here because
    #     family_init cannot index a look-ahead-guarded Series -------------
    per = 14
    atr = [None] * n
    tr_sum = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        tr = hi[i] - lo[i] if i == 0 else max(hi[i] - lo[i],
                                              abs(hi[i] - cl[i - 1]),
                                              abs(lo[i] - cl[i - 1]))
        if i < per:
            tr_sum += tr
            if i == per - 1:
                atr[i] = tr_sum / per
        else:
            atr[i] = (atr[i - 1] * (per - 1) + tr) / per

    av = [None] * n
    s = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        s += vo[i]
        if i >= 20:
            s -= vo[i - 20]
        if i >= 19:
            av[i] = s / 20.0

    # --- rolling extremes over the ex_n bars ending at i ------------------
    def _extreme(vals, want_min):
        out = [None] * n
        dq = []                      # monotonic deque of indices
        for i in range(n):
            while dq and dq[0] <= i - ex_n:
                dq.pop(0)
            while dq and ((vals[dq[-1]] >= vals[i]) if want_min
                          else (vals[dq[-1]] <= vals[i])):
                dq.pop()
            dq.append(i)
            if i >= ex_n - 1:
                out[i] = vals[dq[0]]
        return out

    ll = _extreme(lo, True)
    hh = _extreme(hi, False)

    sig = [0] * n
    tgt = [None] * n
    stp = [None] * n

    def _trigger(ti, up, base, ext, move, a):
        """First bar closing beyond the test bar on real volume. Returns True
        when this setup is finished either way."""
        for j in range(ti + 1, min(n, ti + 1 + trig_win)):
            if (cl[j] < base) if up else (cl[j] > base):
                return True                  # climax extreme lost: setup dead
            vv = av[j]
            if vv is None or vv <= 0:
                continue
            if (cl[j] > hi[ti]) if up else (cl[j] < lo[ti]):
                if vo[j] < trig_vol * vv:
                    return False             # broke the test, nobody came
                if sig[j] == 0:
                    sig[j] = 1 if up else -1
                    tgt[j] = ext + mm * move if up else ext - mm * move
                    stp[j] = base - stop_pad * a if up else base + stop_pad * a
                return True
        return False

    def _walk(c, up):
        """One climax candidate. up=True is the accumulation (long) case."""
        a = atr[c]
        rng = hi[c] - lo[c]
        if a is None or a <= 0 or rng <= 0:
            return
        base = lo[c] if up else hi[c]
        # ---- automatic rally / reaction ----
        ai = None
        ext = None
        for j in range(c + 1, min(n, c + 1 + ar_win)):
            if (cl[j] < base) if up else (cl[j] > base):
                return                       # climax extreme broken: dead
            if ext is None or ((hi[j] > ext) if up else (lo[j] < ext)):
                ext = hi[j] if up else lo[j]
                ai = j
        if ai is None or ext is None:
            return
        move = (ext - base) if up else (base - ext)
        if move < ar_atr * a or move / rng < ratio_min:
            return                           # the ratio gate: a weak rally
        # ---- secondary test: any qualifying bar in the window may be it,
        #      and the first one that produces a trigger is the trade ------
        for ti in range(ai + st_lo, min(n, ai + st_hi + 1)):
            if (cl[ti] < base) if up else (cl[ti] > base):
                return
            edge = lo[ti] if up else hi[ti]
            if up:
                near = base <= edge <= base + st_band * a
            else:
                near = base - st_band * a <= edge <= base
            if not near:
                continue
            if vo[ti] > st_vol * vo[c]:
                continue
            if (hi[ti] - lo[ti]) > st_spread * a:
                continue
            if _trigger(ti, up, base, ext, move, a):
                return

    for c in range(n):
        a = atr[c]
        vv = av[c]
        if a is None or vv is None or vv <= 0:
            continue
        if (hi[c] - lo[c]) < smult * a or vo[c] < vmult * vv:
            continue
        if ll[c] is not None and lo[c] <= ll[c]:
            _walk(c, True)
        if hh[c] is not None and hi[c] >= hh[c]:
            _walk(c, False)

    ctx.sig = ctx.series(sig, "wyckoff_signal")
    ctx.tgt = ctx.series(tgt, "measured_move")
    ctx.stp = ctx.series(stp, "climax_stop")
    ctx._lvl = None


def signal(ctx, i):
    s = ctx.sig[i]
    if s and not ctx.positions:
        ctx._lvl = (s, ctx.tgt[i], ctx.stp[i])
    return s


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    """Measured-move target off the automatic rally, or the climax extreme
    gives way. Both are checked on the close; the harness time stop does the
    rest.
    """
    lv = ctx._lvl
    if not lv:
        return False
    d, t, st = lv
    px = ctx.c[i]
    if d > 0:
        return (t is not None and px >= t) or (st is not None and px <= st)
    return (t is not None and px <= t) or (st is not None and px >= st)
